description:
The sending inbox's settings and the pitch sequences (Settings → Sending inbox, Sequences).
action:
- signature(inboxId, signature): An inbox's signature (empty clears it).
- daily_limit(inboxId, dailyLimit): An inbox's sends per day, 1 to 30. A raise restarts the warm-up climb.
- warm_up(inboxId, on): An inbox's warm-up on or off. Off sends the whole daily limit from today, which hurts a new inbox's deliverability.
- send_window(startHour?, endHour?, timezone?, weekdaysOnly?, dailyLimit?): When mail goes out: hours, timezone, weekdays only, the default daily limit.
- opt_out(on?, lines?): The opt-out line under every email: on, and its lines (null puts Sightkick's back).
- postal_address(address): The postal address under every email (empty clears it).
- disconnect_inbox(inboxId): Take an inbox off (get_settings inbox): it stops sending and hearing replies, its queued sends are cancelled, its threads keep their history. A managed inbox taken off is cancelled with its domain. Connecting one again is the owner's sign-in.
- create_managed_inbox(domain, firstName, lastName, username?, platform?, redirectUrl?): Order the managed inbox: the domain and one mailbox in the sender's name (username before the @, the first name when left out; GOOGLE or MICROSOFT; redirectUrl where the domain forwards, the site when left out). It connects itself in minutes, warm-up on. One inbox per brand: refused while another is being set up or an earlier one still listens. A new managed inbox needs the old one disconnected first, and charges the domain fee again to the plan's card. The same order asked again returns it, nothing charged.
- save_sequence(sequenceId?, name?, pitch?, followUps?): Create a sequence (no sequenceId: inactive) or edit one: name, pitch (subject, body), followUps (enabled, days, body). What's left out stays.
- duplicate_sequence(sequenceId): An inactive copy.
- activate_sequence(sequenceId): Make it the one active sequence (ends a split test in its favour).
- split_test(sequenceId): Run it beside the active one: new pitches alternate.
- end_split_test(sequenceId): Take it out of the split test.
- archive_sequence(sequenceId): Archive an inactive sequence with its numbers.
- unarchive_sequence(sequenceId): Bring an archived sequence back, inactive.
- remove_sequence(sequenceId): Delete a sequence never used (a used one is archived instead). Can't be undone.

sequenceId.description: A sequence's id (get_outreach sequences), null for the Default
